name.en: GT2 20-tooth toothed idler, 9 mm belt, 5 mm bore
name.es: Polea loca dentada GT2 de 20 dientes, banda de 9 mm, barreno de 5 mm
name.fr: Galet denté GT2 à 20 dents, courroie de 9 mm, alésage de 5 mm
name.pt: Polia louca dentada GT2 de 20 dentes, correia de 9 mm, furo de 5 mm

description.en: A flanged GT2 toothed idler for 9 mm belt: 20 teeth on a body that turns on a pair of ball bearings with a 5 mm bore, so it rides on an M5 screw used as an axle. A commercial class: the bore, tooth count, belt width and outside diameter are what the cited listings share; the overall width varies by maker and is a parameter.
description.es: Una polea loca dentada GT2 con pestañas para banda de 9 mm: 20 dientes en un cuerpo que gira sobre un par de rodamientos de bolas con barreno de 5 mm, de modo que monta sobre un tornillo M5 usado como eje. Una clase comercial: el barreno, el número de dientes, el ancho de banda y el diámetro exterior son lo que comparten los listados citados; el ancho total varía según el fabricante y es un parámetro.
description.fr: Un galet denté GT2 à flasques pour courroie de 9 mm : 20 dents sur un corps qui tourne sur deux roulements à billes d'alésage 5 mm, si bien qu'il se monte sur une vis M5 utilisée comme axe. Une classe commerciale : l'alésage, le nombre de dents, la largeur de courroie et le diamètre extérieur sont ce que partagent les fiches citées ; la largeur totale varie selon le fabricant et est un paramètre.
description.pt: Uma polia louca dentada GT2 com flanges para correia de 9 mm: 20 dentes num corpo que gira sobre um par de rolamentos de esferas com furo de 5 mm, de modo que monta num parafuso M5 usado como eixo. Uma classe comercial: o furo, o número de dentes, a largura da correia e o diâmetro exterior são o que as listagens citadas partilham; a largura total varia conforme o fabricante e é um parâmetro.

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of face A (the outer face of one flange), on the axis. +z runs along the axis through the idler to face B at z = width_mm. +x is an arbitrary radial reference: the idler is round, so every interface has continuous symmetry. The bore and face A share the origin; both normals there point −z, out of face A.

outside_diameter.note: the flange diameter, the largest diameter of the body

overall_width_gates.note: Gates G2GT-I-20-9 overall height (along the axis); the default of width_mm

parameters.note: Flange face to flange face along the axis. The default is the Gates G2GT-I-20-9 overall height (cited); other makers differ. The minimum is the 9 mm belt width (cited) and the maximum a catalog convention.

interfaces.note: Female: the bearings' 5 mm bore receives the screw's shank. Framed at face A, normal −z out of the face, so a journal framed where face A lands (normal toward the tip) puts the idler beyond it along the screw.
Neutral: face A bears on the next part of a stack on the same axle (a shim, a host wall).
Neutral: face B, width_mm along the axis, bears on the next part of a stack.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (P4-AUTH-E lane, 2026-10-04); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: The belt path is not an interface yet: no catalog belt exists to mate it. The pitch diameter of a 20-tooth GT2 wheel is the interface-sizes key gt2-pulley-20t-5mm's. The flange faces bear on shims or host walls; whether a maker's flange or inner ring stands proud is not stated by the sources and is not modelled.
